values.Shock symptom: Stiff travel: High compression damping counterclockwise about 1/6 turn; set sunken length 90-100 mm; replace with soft spring

values.Fork symptom: Soft over entire range, bo: Compression damping: turn adjuster clockwise about 2 clicks; increase oil amount by about 5-10 cm³; replace with stiff spring
values.Fork symptom: Stiff toward stroke end: Decrease oil amount by about 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz)
values.Fork symptom: Soft toward stroke end, bo: Increase oil amount by about 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz)

values.Shock symptom: Spongy and unstable: Rebound damping clockwise about 2 clicks; low compression damping clockwise about 1 click; replace with stiff spring
values.Shock symptom: Heavy and dragging: Rebound damping counterclockwise about 2 clicks; replace with soft spring
values.Shock symptom: Poor road gripping: Rebound damping counterclockwise about 2 clicks; low compression clockwise about 1 click; high compression clockwise about 1/6 turn; set sunken length 90-100 mm; replace with soft spring
values.Shock symptom: Bottoming out: High compression damping clockwise about 1/6 turn; set sunken length 90-100 mm; replace with stiff spring
values.Shock symptom: Bouncing: Rebound damping clockwise about 2 clicks; replace with soft spring
values.Shock symptom: Stiff travel: High compression damping counterclockwise about 1/6 turn; set sunken length 90-100 mm; replace with soft spring
values.Shock symptom: Adjustment increments: Rebound in 2-click steps; low compression in 1-click steps; high compression in 1/6-turn steps
